tool_signatures.name: add_audio_track
tool_signatures.description: Add a master audio track + sound section to a Level Sequence.

tool_signatures.name: add_blueprint_function
tool_signatures.description: Add a new empty function graph to an existing UBlueprint.

tool_signatures.name: add_blueprint_node
tool_signatures.description: Add a K2 node (call_function / variable_get / variable_set / branch) to a Blueprint event or function graph; returns the new node's GUID + pins.

tool_signatures.name: add_blueprint_variable
tool_signatures.description: Add a typed member variable (bool/int/float/string/name/vector/rotator/transform/object) to an existing UBlueprint.

tool_signatures.name: add_camera_cut_track
tool_signatures.description: Add (or reuse) the camera-cut track and bind a camera over a [start, end] frame range.

tool_signatures.name: add_cine_camera_to_sequence
tool_signatures.description: Spawn an ACineCameraActor and add it as a possessable binding; returns the binding GUID (feed it to add_camera_cut_track).

tool_signatures.name: add_component
tool_signatures.description: Attach a component (UActorComponent / USceneComponent subclass) to an existing actor at runtime, optionally socketed.

tool_signatures.name: add_material_expression
tool_signatures.description: Create a UMaterialExpression node inside an existing UMaterial's graph, then recompile the material.

tool_signatures.name: add_visibility_track
tool_signatures.description: Add an actor-visibility track that keys an actor shown/hidden over time (inverted bHidden).

tool_signatures.name: apply_python_to_selection
tool_signatures.description: Run a Python snippet with the editor's current selection bound as actors / assets.

tool_signatures.name: bind_actor_to_sequence
tool_signatures.description: Add a level actor as a possessable binding to a Level Sequence.

tool_signatures.name: build_lighting
tool_signatures.description: Invoke a static-lighting build on the active editor world. Non-interactive; may take time on large levels.

tool_signatures.name: bulk_fix_redirectors
tool_signatures.description: Resolve redirectors across many content folders in one call. Composes fix_up_redirectors per folder. Bridge-side synthetic.

tool_signatures.name: bulk_focus_actors
tool_signatures.description: Frame the viewport on each actor in a sequence, optionally screenshotting each one. Composes focus_actor (+ get_viewport_screenshot) per name. Bridge-side synthetic.

tool_signatures.name: bulk_screenshot_actors
tool_signatures.description: Focus + screenshot each actor in a sequence. Composes screenshot_actor per name. Bridge-side synthetic.

tool_signatures.name: bulk_set_actor_property
tool_signatures.description: Apply many {actor, property, value} mutations in one call. Composes set_actor_property per assignment. Bridge-side synthetic.

tool_signatures.name: bulk_set_console_variables
tool_signatures.description: Set many CVars in one call with optional atomic rollback. Composes get_console_variable + set_console_variable. Bridge-side synthetic.

tool_signatures.name: cancel_task
tool_signatures.description: Cancel an in-flight task by id.

tool_signatures.name: compare_assets
tool_signatures.description: Symmetric diff between two assets' inspect_asset outputs. Bridge-side synthetic.

tool_signatures.name: compile_blueprint
tool_signatures.description: Recompile a Blueprint asset and report errors.

tool_signatures.name: configure_texture
tool_signatures.description: Adjust SRGB / compression / LOD group / filter on an existing texture asset.

tool_signatures.name: connect_blueprint_pins
tool_signatures.description: Wire two pins (exec or data) between nodes by GUID + pin name, via the schema-validated UEdGraphSchema_K2::TryCreateConnection.

tool_signatures.name: connect_material_expression
tool_signatures.description: Wire an expression's output to a material property input (property:BaseColor) or another expression's input (node:<ExprName>:<InputName>), then recompile.

tool_signatures.name: create_blueprint
tool_signatures.description: Create a new UBlueprint asset under /Game/ from a parent class (default /Script/Engine.Actor).

tool_signatures.name: create_data_asset
tool_signatures.description: Create a new UDataAsset (or subclass) asset from a UDataAsset subclass path.

tool_signatures.name: create_data_table
tool_signatures.description: Create a new UDataTable asset whose rows conform to a given row UScriptStruct.

tool_signatures.name: create_level
tool_signatures.description: Create a new empty level (UWorld) asset under /Game/ and open it as the active level.

tool_signatures.name: create_material_instance
tool_signatures.description: Create a UMaterialInstanceConstant asset with a parent material set.

tool_signatures.name: create_sequence
tool_signatures.description: Create a new empty Level Sequence asset with a configured display rate and playback range.

tool_signatures.name: delete_actor
tool_signatures.description: Remove an actor by name. Force flag overrides children-attached safety check.

tool_signatures.name: delete_asset
tool_signatures.description: Delete an asset; refuses if referenced by other packages unless force=true.

tool_signatures.name: duplicate_actor
tool_signatures.description: Clone an existing level actor (label or FName), optionally offset and relabel. Undoable (single Ctrl+Z).

tool_signatures.name: duplicate_asset
tool_signatures.description: Copy an asset to a new path.

tool_signatures.name: edit_widget_tree
tool_signatures.description: Mutate the tree: set_root / add_child / set_property. Solves the EUW WidgetTree blocker.

tool_signatures.name: exec_python_persistent
tool_signatures.description: Persistent Python session — variables defined in one call survive into the next.

tool_signatures.name: execute_console_command
tool_signatures.description: Run a UE console command (e.g. stat fps, r.ScreenPercentage 50) and capture its output.

tool_signatures.name: execute_unreal_python
tool_signatures.description: Universal escape hatch — run arbitrary unreal. Python in the editor's interpreter. Multi-line scripts work.

tool_signatures.name: find_actors_by_class
tool_signatures.description: Filter the active level's actors by class. Composes get_actors_in_level and matches against the short class name. Bridge-side synthetic.

tool_signatures.name: find_assets
tool_signatures.description: Query the asset registry by class + path + name.

tool_signatures.name: find_console_variables
tool_signatures.description: Enumerate console variables matching a name pattern.

tool_signatures.name: fix_up_redirectors
tool_signatures.description: Resolve all object redirectors under a folder.

tool_signatures.name: focus_actor
tool_signatures.description: Select an actor by label and frame the viewport on it.

tool_signatures.name: get_actors_in_level
tool_signatures.description: Name / class / transform of every actor; optional case-insensitive substring filter.

tool_signatures.name: get_camera_transform
tool_signatures.description: Read the level-editor viewport camera's location + rotation. Composes execute_unreal_python + get_log_lines via the marker pattern.

tool_signatures.name: get_console_variable
tool_signatures.description: Read a single console variable's current value.

tool_signatures.name: get_log_lines
tool_signatures.description: Read recent UE Output Log entries from the in-process ring buffer. Filter by category and minimum verbosity.

tool_signatures.name: get_project_summary
tool_signatures.description: Project name, engine version, enabled plugins, asset count.

tool_signatures.name: get_viewport_screenshot
tool_signatures.description: Active viewport as a PNG written to a project-confined disk path (throttle-proof fresh frame; optional small inline thumbnail).

tool_signatures.name: import_texture
tool_signatures.description: Bring an image file (PNG / JPG / EXR / TGA / BMP / HDR) from disk into the project as a UTexture2D asset via UE's canonical import path.

tool_signatures.name: inspect_anim_blueprint
tool_signatures.description: Read variables and state machines of an Animation Blueprint.

tool_signatures.name: inspect_anim_montage
tool_signatures.description: Read sections, slots, and notify tracks of an UAnimMontage.

tool_signatures.name: inspect_asset
tool_signatures.description: Class, tags, dependencies, referencers, on-disk size.

tool_signatures.name: inspect_blueprint
tool_signatures.description: Variables, function/event graphs, parent class of any Blueprint asset.

tool_signatures.name: inspect_curve
tool_signatures.description: UCurveBase channel layout (1ch UCurveFloat / 4ch UCurveLinearColor / 3ch UCurveVector), per-channel name + key count + per-channel + global time/value range.

tool_signatures.name: inspect_data_table
tool_signatures.description: RowStruct identity, sorted row names, per-property name+type for every FProperty on the row struct, plus client-strip / ignore-extra/missing-fields flags.

tool_signatures.name: inspect_dependency_graph
tool_signatures.description: BFS the asset dependency graph (down by default, optional bidirectional sweep). Composes inspect_asset recursively. Bridge-side synthetic.

tool_signatures.name: inspect_landscape
tool_signatures.description: Components, layers, and material info for a landscape actor.

tool_signatures.name: inspect_material
tool_signatures.description: List parameter names declared by a UMaterial or UMaterialInstance (scalar/vector/texture/static-switch).

tool_signatures.name: inspect_material_instance
tool_signatures.description: Read a material instance's parent + currently-overridden parameter values.

tool_signatures.name: inspect_niagara_system
tool_signatures.description: Emitters and exposed user parameters of a Niagara system.

tool_signatures.name: inspect_physics_asset
tool_signatures.description: Body setups (one per simulated bone), constraint setups (joints between bodies), bounds-bodies subset, named physical-animation + constraint profiles. Cross-links to inspect_skeletal_mesh via preview_skeletal_mesh.

tool_signatures.name: inspect_sequence
tool_signatures.description: Read structure of a Level Sequence: tracks, sections, bindings, frame rate, playback range.

tool_signatures.name: inspect_skeletal_mesh
tool_signatures.description: LODs, materials, sockets, skeleton info for a USkeletalMesh.

tool_signatures.name: inspect_sound_attenuation
tool_signatures.description: USoundAttenuation 3D-playback rules: distance algorithm + shape, spatialization, air-absorption LPF/HPF, listener focus, occlusion tracing, reverb send, priority attenuation, plus assorted feature flags. Each major feature is gated by its master bitfield; sub-objects collapse to {enabled: false} when disabled.

tool_signatures.name: inspect_sound_cue
tool_signatures.description: USoundCue duration, multipliers, attenuation cross-link, root sound-node class, full graph node list (sorted, with class taxonomy).

tool_signatures.name: inspect_sound_wave
tool_signatures.description: USoundWave sample rate, channels, frame count, duration, compression type + runtime format + compressed-data size, sound group, looping/streaming flags, loading behavior, subtitle + cue-point + loop-region counts. Editor-only LUFS / sample-peak / comment fields conditional.

tool_signatures.name: inspect_static_mesh
tool_signatures.description: LODs, materials, collision, bounds for a UStaticMesh.

tool_signatures.name: inspect_texture
tool_signatures.description: Texture class, surface dimensions, sRGB, compression, filter, LOD group, mip-gen, virtual-texture / never-stream flags, composite-texture cross-link. UTexture2D-specific size / mips / pixel format / imported source dimensions emitted conditionally.

tool_signatures.name: inspect_widget_blueprint
tool_signatures.description: Widget-BP-specific surface: animations, delegate bindings, palette category, inherited named slots, property-binding count, blueprint compile status. Pairs with inspect_blueprint + inspect_widget_tree.

tool_signatures.name: inspect_widget_tree
tool_signatures.description: Read the widget hierarchy of a UWidgetBlueprint or EUW (the thing UE Python can't do).

tool_signatures.name: list_tasks
tool_signatures.description: Enumerate all tracked tasks and their states.

tool_signatures.name: list_tools
tool_signatures.description: Names of every registered method (for autodiscovery).

tool_signatures.name: load_level_by_path
tool_signatures.description: Open a level by package path.

tool_signatures.name: move_asset
tool_signatures.description: Move an asset to a different folder; UE creates a redirector at the source path.

tool_signatures.name: poll_events
tool_signatures.description: Drain queued editor events (actor spawn/delete, asset add/remove/rename/import, level save, map change) from the in-process EventBus.

tool_signatures.name: poll_subscription
tool_signatures.description: Drain queued events from a specific subscription.

tool_signatures.name: poll_task
tool_signatures.description: Read a task's current state / result.

tool_signatures.name: redo_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Step the editor undo stack forward — the programmatic Ctrl+Y. Re-applies transactions previously reverted by undo_transaction (or Ctrl+Z), up to count steps.

tool_signatures.name: register_subscription
tool_signatures.description: Open a per-client subscription channel for a filtered event stream.

tool_signatures.name: rename_actor
tool_signatures.description: Change an actor's World Outliner display label (SetActorLabel); the stable FName is unchanged. Undoable.

tool_signatures.name: rename_asset
tool_signatures.description: Change an asset's leaf name in place; UE creates a redirector at the old name.

tool_signatures.name: render_camera_to_png
tool_signatures.description: Force a synchronous render of the level-editor viewport (or an off-screen SceneCapture2D at arbitrary resolution) and write a PNG — works headless where deferred screenshots fail.

tool_signatures.name: render_sequence_mrq
tool_signatures.description: Async-render a Level Sequence (optional map override) to PNG / JPG / BMP / EXR via Movie Render Queue; returns a task_id (completion via poll_task).

tool_signatures.name: reset_python_state
tool_signatures.description: Wipe the persistent session's globals.

tool_signatures.name: run_python_file
tool_signatures.description: Execute a .py file from disk in the editor's Python interpreter.

tool_signatures.name: screenshot_actor
tool_signatures.description: Frame the viewport on a specific actor and capture a focused PNG. Composes focus_actor + get_viewport_screenshot.

tool_signatures.name: set_actor_folder
tool_signatures.description: Set an actor's World Outliner folder path (e.g. Lighting/Key); empty string moves it to the outliner root. Undoable.

tool_signatures.name: set_actor_property
tool_signatures.description: Mutate any UPROPERTY on an actor. Supports primitives, FName/FText, vectors, rotators, colors, enums, and TSoftObjectPtr.

tool_signatures.name: set_actor_transform
tool_signatures.description: Move / rotate / scale an existing actor by name. Absolute or relative mode.

tool_signatures.name: set_blueprint_node_pin_default
tool_signatures.description: Set a literal or object default on an input pin (verified by read-back).

tool_signatures.name: set_camera_transform
tool_signatures.description: Set the level-editor viewport camera's location and/or rotation. Single execute_unreal_python round-trip.

tool_signatures.name: set_console_variable
tool_signatures.description: Write a value to a console variable.

tool_signatures.name: set_mi_parameter
tool_signatures.description: Override a scalar/vector/texture parameter on a material instance. Type discriminator picks value shape.

tool_signatures.name: set_niagara_user_param
tool_signatures.description: Set a user-exposed Niagara parameter (float / vec3 / linear-color / bool) on a placed Niagara component, with type-match validation. Undoable.

tool_signatures.name: set_sequence_playback_range
tool_signatures.description: Set a Level Sequence's playback start/end (display-rate frames).

tool_signatures.name: spawn_actor
tool_signatures.description: Create an actor at a location with optional rotation, label, and initial properties. Class path supports built-ins and Blueprints.

tool_signatures.name: spawn_niagara_at_location
tool_signatures.description: Place a Niagara system in the level (ANiagaraActor + SetAsset) at a world transform; optional auto-activate. Undoable.

tool_signatures.name: spawn_niagara_attached
tool_signatures.description: Attach a Niagara system component to an existing actor, optionally socketed. Undoable.

tool_signatures.name: start_sleep_task
tool_signatures.description: Reference long-running task — sleeps for N seconds. Used to exercise the task pattern from clients.

tool_signatures.name: take_high_res_screenshot
tool_signatures.description: Trigger UE's HighResShot console command.

tool_signatures.name: undo_transaction
tool_signatures.description: Step the editor undo stack backward — the programmatic Ctrl+Z. Each mutating MCP edit (spawn/delete/transform/property/component) is one transaction, so this reverts the last such edit (or the last N via count).

tool_signatures.name: unsubscribe
tool_signatures.description: Close a subscription.

tool_signatures.name: wait_for_events
tool_signatures.description: Bridge-side synthetic tool — block until matching events arrive or timeout_ms elapses, by polling poll_events at poll_interval_ms cadence.
